import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_kinder import Session
from PIL import Image
s=Session()
m=s.model
sid=m.site('robot_pinch_site').id
armadr=np.arange(32,39)
dof=np.arange(28,35)
d=mujoco.MjData(m)
Rtar=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])
acts=[]
def step(a):
    o,suc,done=s.step(a); acts.append(np.array(a))
    if suc: print('SUCCESS',s.t)
    return suc

def ik(pos,base=None):
    d.qpos[:]=s.data.qpos
    if base is not None: d.qpos[29:32]=base
    q0=s.data.qpos[32:39].copy()
    def fun(q):
        d.qpos[32:39]=q
        mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
        rot=Rotation.from_matrix(Rtar@d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
        return np.r_[5*(d.site_xpos[sid]-pos),rot, .0001*(q-q0)]
    lo=np.array([-np.inf,-2.23,-np.inf,-2.56,-np.inf,-2.08,-np.inf]);hi=-lo
    sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,lo+.0001,hi-.0001),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=200)
    if np.linalg.norm(fun(sol.x)[:6])>.01: print('IK err',fun(sol.x)[:6])
    return sol.x

def move(pos,g=0,n=120,base=None):
    q=ik(np.array(pos),base)
    for i in range(n):
        a=np.zeros(11); a[10]=g
        a[3:10]=np.clip(q-s.data.qpos[32:39],-.07,.07)
        if base is not None:a[:3]=np.clip(np.array(base)-s.data.qpos[29:32],-.04,.04)
        if step(a):return
        err=np.linalg.norm(s.data.site_xpos[sid]-pos)
        qe=np.max(np.abs(q-s.data.qpos[32:39]))
        if i>5 and err<.002 and qe<.008:break
    print('move',s.t,'ee',s.data.site_xpos[sid],'err',err,'qerr',qe)

def wait(n,g):
    for i in range(n):
        a=np.zeros(11);a[10]=g;step(a)
def report():
    print('objects',[(name,s.data.xpos[m.body(name).id].round(4)) for name in ['small_block_1','small_block_2','large_block','seesaw_1']])
def snap(name):Image.fromarray(s.images(['task_view'])['task_view']).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
if __name__=='__main__':
    p=s.data.xpos[m.body('small_block_1').id].copy()
    move([p[0],p[1],.25],base=[.22,.10,0]);snap('above')
    move([p[0],p[1],.015]);snap('down')
    wait(15,1);snap('closed');report()
    move([p[0],p[1],.25],1);snap('lift');report()
    s.save_trajectory(acts,'/app/output/trial.npz')
PY
